correctness.rationale: The binomial moment identity E(delta^K)=(1-u+u delta)^(ell-1) gives the displayed gradient for fixed strategy-independent weights. For every ell>=2, positive delta, each polynomial summand is convex; if one ell>=3 with delta !=1 its second derivative is strictly positive in the interior. Under the stated absolute uniform-endpoint summability, the series converges uniformly and its limit is convex, so no more than two isolated interior crossings are possible; affine/constant degeneracies are distinguished. For strict convexity the two-intersection criterion min G<1/r<min{G(0),G(1)} follows by continuity and monotonicity on either side of the unique minimum, giving the stability signs and full-cooperation attraction. Independently expanded the (2,3,4) example exactly: G=19/48-11u/96+25u^2/192-u^3/128 and rG-1=-(3u-2)(u^2-16u+4)/144; the only interior roots are 8-2sqrt(15), 2/3. Finite random samples in verify.py are diagnostic, not proof of uniform arbitrary or countable mixtures.
